formal_education.institution: The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda (MSUB)
formal_education.content:
Currently pursuing Master of Computer Applications with focus on advanced computer science concepts, software engineering practices, and emerging technologies. The program builds upon undergraduate computer science foundation with emphasis on practical application and research.

Coursework includes advanced algorithms, database systems, software architecture, machine learning, and system design. Program designed to prepare students for senior technical roles in software industry.

Active participation in academic projects, research activities, and industry collaborations to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies.

formal_education.institution: The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda (MSUB)
formal_education.content:
Completed Bachelor of Computer Applications program with comprehensive foundation in computer science fundamentals. Curriculum covered programming languages, data structures, algorithms, database management, web development, and software engineering principles.

Gained practical experience through multiple programming projects, internships, and hands-on laboratory work. Developed strong problem-solving skills and proficiency in multiple programming paradigms.

Program provided solid foundation for pursuing advanced studies and professional career in computer science and software development.

certifications.name: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
certifications.content:
Advanced certification in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, covering the integration of retrieval mechanisms with large language models to enhance response accuracy and relevance. Program focused on practical implementation of RAG architectures and optimization techniques.

Learned to build and deploy RAG systems using various vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval strategies. Covered advanced topics including query optimization, context window management, and evaluation metrics for RAG systems.

Directly applicable to building intelligent information systems and enhancing AI applications with external knowledge sources.

certifications.name: Deep Dive into GPU Computing
certifications.issuing_organization: C-DAC (Centre for Development of Advanced Computing)
certifications.content:
Comprehensive certification in GPU computing and parallel programming, covering CUDA programming, GPU architecture, and high-performance computing applications. Program focused on leveraging GPU acceleration for computational intensive tasks.

Gained hands-on experience with CUDA programming, memory management, parallel algorithms, and performance optimization techniques. Covered applications in scientific computing, machine learning, and data processing.

Valuable for implementing high-performance computing solutions and optimizing computational workloads in AI/ML applications.

certifications.name: Machine Learning with Python
certifications.content:
Comprehensive certification covering machine learning fundamentals and implementation using Python. Program included supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms, model evaluation, and practical implementation using popular ML libraries.

Hands-on projects included data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training and evaluation, and deployment strategies. Gained proficiency with scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, and matplotlib for complete ML workflows.

Directly applicable to building and deploying machine learning solutions in various domains including prediction, classification, and clustering problems.

certifications.name: Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals
certifications.content:
Foundation certification in artificial intelligence covering core AI concepts, applications, and ethical considerations. Program provided comprehensive overview of AI landscape including machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and robotics.

Covered practical AI applications across various industries, AI development lifecycle, and responsible AI practices. Gained understanding of AI's impact on business and society, along with hands-on experience with IBM Watson services.

Valuable foundation for understanding AI ecosystem and implementing AI solutions in enterprise environments.
skills_validated: Machine learning and deep learning basics
AI ethics and responsible AI practices
IBM Watson services and cloud AI tools

certifications.name: Supervised Machine Learning: Regression and Classification
certifications.content:
Foundational machine learning certification focusing on supervised learning algorithms for regression and classification problems. Program covered mathematical foundations, algorithm implementation, and practical application of key ML techniques.

Hands-on implementation of linear regression, logistic regression, decision trees, and neural networks using Python and popular ML libraries. Emphasis on understanding algorithm mechanics, model evaluation, and avoiding overfitting.

Provided strong foundation for advanced machine learning studies and practical ML implementation in real-world applications.
